title: How does the room reach your eyes?
objectives: Learn the gestures: explode, trace, unplug, replug, collapse.
See how one missing connection darkens everything after it.

steps.caption: This is a simplified model of a headset like the one you're wearing. It is a teaching model, not the device's actual internals. Press Explode to open it up, or pinch with both hands and pull apart.
steps.hint: Press Explode. You can also pinch with both hands and pull them apart.

steps.caption: Press Trace to follow the room from the front cameras to your eyes.
steps.hint: The Trace button is in the panel next to you.

steps.caption: Unplug the link between the front cameras and the processor board.
steps.hint: Select the highlighted link, then press Unplug.

on_enter.text: This link carries what the cameras see.

steps.caption: Before you look: point at the first part that loses what it needs.
steps.hint: Which part was the link feeding?

on_enter.question: Which part loses its input first?

feedback.correct: Right. The processor gets no camera images, so the display and lenses after it have no room to show.
feedback.incorrect: Not quite. The processor loses its camera images first, so the display and lenses after it have no room to show.

steps.caption: With no camera images, nothing of the room reaches the display or the lenses. This is the teaching model's rule, not a measurement of your headset.
Plug the link back into the right socket.
steps.hint: The link came from the cameras. Which part needs to see the room?

steps.caption: The room reaches your eyes again. Press Collapse to close it up, or push your hands together. Next: the same moves on a real codebase.
steps.hint: Press Collapse. You can also bring your hands together.
